A '''military space station''' was located in the [[Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array]] that orbited the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. The military facility was sandwiched between drydocks and a warehouse.<ref name="CatCW" />
